تختطفوا (form VIII)
# تَخْتَطِفُوا (taḵtaṭifū) /tax.ta.tˤi.fuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَطَفَ (iḵtaṭafa)
# تُخْتَطَفُوا (tuḵtaṭafū) /tux.ta.tˤa.fuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَطَفَ (iḵtaṭafa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
